source_text: The assay, named MiFish-U-12S, targeted the 12S rRNA mitochondrial gene using a two-step PCR protocol. Each 20 uL PCR reaction contained 2 uL of template DNA, 1 uL of each primer at a stock concentration of 10 uM, and 10 uL of a commercial KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix master mix. Thermocycling was performed on a Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler.
